resolution.reason: Exact production route already distinguishes developmental surveillance, screening, comprehensive diagnosis, result interpretation and what to bring.
Existing pages already cover the assessment question, developmental history, direct observation, standardized tools, health checks, reporting and post-assessment planning.
Existing adult/late-diagnosis guide has a dedicated adult-assessment section and post-diagnosis pathway.
Two production pages already address women/girls, masking, delayed recognition and assessment implications.
Developmental history, contextual records and a practical information file are already first-class sections.
Differential diagnosis is already covered by a comprehensive guide, Wave001 clinical-literacy page and a focused autism-ADHD reference.
Current assessment page states that scales are not diagnosis but does not serve the focused screening/rating-vs-diagnosis intent.
Current assessment page is lifespan-generic; adult developmental history, impairment across adult roles, retrospective evidence and adult differentials justify a separate intent.
Current content does not center the decision problem of cross-setting evidence and discrepant parent/teacher observations.
A focused scale-interpretation page adds independent value on informants, thresholds, context and false certainty without diagnosing.
Wave001 already provides a dedicated differential-diagnosis page for ADHD.
Existing ADHD assessment guide already contains an interview information file and practical decision questions; improve it rather than create a competitor.
